title: E-Wallet, Modal by @jeetnirnejak: Savings Vault: a locked savings door that dials a combination, swings
notes:
Savings Vault: a locked savings door that dials a combination, swings open, and counts up what's inside. each combo landing overshoots a few degrees, then settles. that wobble is baked into the keyframes, so replay always clicks the same way.

Designer: @jeetnirnejak. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
